# TRL-VAR-0015: Deployment output key depends on a resource that is not statically known

- Severity: warning
- Exit class: none
- Area: VAR
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active
- Fidelity: approximated

## Remediation

Use a literal environment resource name so the Deploy_<resource> or <hook>_<resource> output key can be derived.

## Example

```json
{"code": "TRL-VAR-0015", "severity": "warning", "params": {"name": "<name>"}}
```
